text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oil Minister Isa al-Mazeedi says drop in world oil prices due to end of winter season.
- Kuwait's Interior Ministry launches campaign to seize unliecensed arms.
- Egypt's exports to Kuwait in 1995 amounted to $65 million, Egyptian diplomat says.
- MP says 80 percent of drugs come in from Iran.
- Kuwait pays its Arab League membership fees.
- Parliamentary panel seeks formation of an Arab common market.
